questions.text: The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), 2023 officially came into legal enforcement across India on which date?
questions.explanation: The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), and Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam (BSA) came into force on 1 July 2024.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.text: Under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, which of the following novel statutory punishments has been introduced for petty offenses?
questions.explanation: Community Service has been introduced as a formal penal punishment for specific petty offenses in BNS.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.text: The 106th Constitutional Amendment Act, 2023 provides for what percentage of reservation for women in the Lok Sabha and State Legislative Assemblies?
questions.explanation: The Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam (106th Amendment Act) reserves one-third (33%) of seats for women.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.text: Under the Chief Election Commissioner and other ECs Act, 2023, who among the following is NOT a member of the Selection Committee?

options.label: C
options.text: Leader of Opposition in Lok Sabha

options.label: D
options.text: A Union Cabinet Minister nominated by PM

questions.explanation: The CJI was substituted by a Union Cabinet Minister nominated by the Prime Minister in the Selection Committee.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.text: Mission Divyastra, successfully flight-tested by DRDO in March 2024, demonstrated which advanced capability on the Agni-5 missile?
questions.explanation: Mission Divyastra proved indigenous MIRV technology on Agni-5, allowing multiple warheads to hit distinct targets.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.text: Which indigenously built nuclear-powered ballistic missile submarine (SSBN) was commissioned into the Indian Navy in August 2024 at Visakhapatnam?
questions.explanation: INS Arighat is India's second indigenous nuclear-powered ballistic missile submarine (SSBN) after INS Arihant.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.text: What is the primary target domain of the National Quantum Mission (NQM) approved by the Union Cabinet?

options.label: B
options.text: Intermediate-scale quantum computers with 50-1000 physical qubits

questions.explanation: NQM targets 50-1000 physical qubit quantum computing, quantum communications, and quantum cryptography.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.text: With the addition of three new wetland sites in 2024, what is the total count of designated Ramsar sites in India as of late 2024?
questions.explanation: India's total Ramsar site tally reached 85 sites in 2024.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.text: Who among the following was NOT conferred the Bharat Ratna award in the year 2024?
questions.explanation: Atal Bihari Vajpayee was conferred the Bharat Ratna in 2015. The 2024 recipients were Karpoori Thakur, L.K. Advani, P.V. Narasimha Rao, Charan Singh, and M.S. Swaminathan.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.text: Late Karpoori Thakur, awarded the Bharat Ratna posthumously in 2024, was the former Chief Minister of which Indian State?
questions.explanation: Karpoori Thakur (Jan Nayak) was a two-time Chief Minister of Bihar and pioneer of backward classes empowerment.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.text: Which of the following nations formally declined to join the BRICS grouping on 1 January 2024 despite being invited at the 15th Johannesburg Summit?
questions.explanation: Argentina under President Javier Milei formally declined to join BRICS on 1 January 2024.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.text: How many new member countries officially became full members of BRICS on 1 January 2024?
questions.explanation: Five countries joined as full members: Egypt, Ethiopia, Iran, Saudi Arabia, and the United Arab Emirates.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.text: Under India's G20 Presidency at the New Delhi Summit, which regional organization was admitted as a permanent full member of the G20?
questions.explanation: The African Union, representing 55 African nations, was admitted as a permanent member of the G20.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.text: Under the Trade and Economic Partnership Agreement (TEPA) signed in March 2024, which economic bloc committed to invest $100 Billion into India over 15 years?
questions.explanation: The European Free Trade Association (Switzerland, Norway, Iceland, Liechtenstein) signed TEPA with India.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.text: The COP28 UN Climate Conference was hosted in which city where the landmark 'UAE Consensus' on transitioning away from fossil fuels was adopted?
questions.explanation: COP28 was held in Dubai, UAE in December 2023.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.text: The COP29 United Nations Climate Change Conference is hosted in which world capital city?
questions.explanation: COP29 is hosted in Baku, Azerbaijan.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.text: The India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor (IMEC) unveiled at the G20 Summit features which Mediterranean port terminal as a primary node connecting Europe?
questions.explanation: IMEC's northern corridor routes from Arabian Gulf rail to Haifa Port in Israel before shipping to Europe.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.text: What was India's rank on the Global Innovation Index (GII) 2024 published by the World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO)?
questions.explanation: India ranked 39th out of 133 economies in the Global Innovation Index 2024.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.text: According to the UNDP Human Development Report 2023-24, what is India's global rank in the Human Development Index (HDI)?
questions.explanation: India ranked 134th out of 193 countries on HDI with a score of 0.644.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.text: Which country's spacecraft became the first in human history to land on the far side of the Moon and retrieve lunar soil samples back to Earth in June 2024?
questions.explanation: China's Chang'e-6 mission retrieved the first-ever physical samples from the lunar far side (South Pole-Aitken basin).
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.text: Which city hosted the 14th BRICS Summit in virtual format under China's chairmanship?
questions.explanation: The 14th BRICS summit was chaired virtually by Beijing, China.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.text: Who was appointed as the first Chief of Defence Staff (CDS) of the Indian Armed Forces?
questions.explanation: General Bipin Rawat was appointed India's first Chief of Defence Staff (CDS) in December 2019.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.text: The Nobel Peace Prize 2023 was conferred upon which human rights defender from Iran?
questions.explanation: Narges Mohammadi was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize 2023 for her fight against the oppression of women in Iran.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.text: Which constitutional article was amended to implement the Goods and Services Tax (GST) in India via the 101st Constitutional Amendment?
questions.explanation: Article 246A was inserted by the 101st Amendment to grant concurrent taxing power over GST to Parliament and State Legislatures.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.text: The headquarters of the International Big Cat Alliance (IBCA) established in 2024 is located in which country?
questions.explanation: The International Big Cat Alliance (IBCA) is headquartered in India with budgetary backing approved in 2024.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.text: Operation Kaveri was launched by the Government of India in 2023 to evacuate Indian citizens from which conflict-ridden nation?
questions.explanation: Operation Kaveri evacuated over 3,800 Indian citizens from Sudan following civil armed conflict in April 2023.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.text: Operation Ajay was launched by India in October 2023 to facilitate the return of Indian citizens from which region?
questions.explanation: Operation Ajay was launched to evacuate Indian citizens from Israel following the October 2023 conflict outbreak.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.text: Which Indian state hosted the Khelo India Youth Games 2024 across four cities (Chennai, Madurai, Trichy, Coimbatore)?
questions.explanation: The 6th Khelo India Youth Games was held in Tamil Nadu in January 2024.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.text: The Dadasaheb Phalke Lifetime Achievement Award for 2021 (conferred in late 2023) was awarded to which legendary actress?
questions.explanation: Veteran actress Waheeda Rehman was honored with the Dadasaheb Phalke Lifetime Achievement Award.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.text: Which island territory of India saw the commissioning of INS Jatayu naval base in March 2024 to bolster Indian Navy's surveillance in the Arabian Sea?
questions.explanation: INS Jatayu was commissioned on Minicoy Island in Lakshadweep, boosting security across the Sea Lines of Communication.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.text: Under the PM-Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana launched in 2024, how many units of free electricity per month are targeted for 1 crore households via rooftop solar?
questions.explanation: PM Surya Ghar Yojana targets up to 300 units of free power monthly for 1 crore households.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.text: Which national park in Madhya Pradesh is the second relocation site chosen for the introduction of African cheetahs under Project Cheetah?
questions.explanation: Gandhi Sagar Wildlife Sanctuary in Madhya Pradesh is prepared as the second home for cheetahs after Kuno NP.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.text: The 'Loss and Damage Fund' to assist developing nations vulnerable to climate change was formally operationalized at which COP summit?
questions.explanation: The Loss and Damage Fund was formally adopted and operationalized on Day 1 of COP28 in Dubai (2023).
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.text: Who is the Chief Justice of India as of mid-2024, heading the Supreme Court of India?
questions.explanation: Justice D. Y. Chandrachud served as the 50th Chief Justice of India (November 2022 to November 2024).
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.text: Which public sector aerospace undertaking in Bengaluru manufactures the Light Combat Aircraft (LCA) Tejas for the Indian Air Force?
questions.explanation: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) headquartered in Bengaluru manufactures the LCA Tejas.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.text: The Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF) Act, 2023 repealed and replaced which statutory scientific funding body?
questions.explanation: ANRF repealed the Science and Engineering Research Board (SERB) Act, 2008 to create a Rs. 50,000 Crore research foundation.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.text: What is the primary objective of the PM Vishwakarma Scheme launched by the Central Government?

options.label: B
options.text: End-to-end support to traditional artisans and craftspeople

options.label: D
options.text: Free health insurance to gig workers

questions.explanation: PM Vishwakarma provides collateral-free loans, skill training, and toolkits to traditional craftspeople across 18 trades.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.text: Which country hosted the G7 Leaders' Summit 2024 in the Apulia region?
questions.explanation: The 50th G7 summit was hosted by Italy in Borgo Egnazia, Apulia in June 2024.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.text: The North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) welcomed which Nordic nation as its 32nd member country in March 2024?
questions.explanation: Sweden officially became the 32nd member of NATO in March 2024 (Finland joined as the 31st member in 2023).
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.text: Who won the ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2024 held in the West Indies and USA?
questions.explanation: India defeated South Africa in the final in Bridgetown, Barbados to win the Men's T20 World Cup 2024.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.text: Who was the founder of the Kadamba dynasty of Banavasi and the author of the Chandravalli inscription?
questions.explanation: Mayurasharma founded the Kadamba dynasty at Banavasi around 345 CE after overcoming the Pallavas.
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: The Halmidi Inscription (ಹಾಲ್ಮಿಡಿ ಶಾಸನ), dated to c. 450 CE, was discovered in which modern district of Karnataka?
questions.explanation: The Halmidi inscription, the earliest recorded stone inscription in Kannada script, was found in Belur taluk, Hassan district.
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: Which Badami Chalukyan emperor assumed the title 'Parameshwara' after defeating Harsha on the banks of river Narmada?
questions.explanation: Pulakeshin II defeated Emperor Harsha on the banks of the Narmada in 618 CE, recorded in the Aihole Inscription by Ravikirti.
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: The magnificent monolithic statue of Gommateshwara at Shravanabelagola was consecrated in 981 CE by which Ganga general?
questions.explanation: Chavundaraya, the military commander of Western Ganga King Rachamalla IV, commissioned the 57-foot Gommateshwara monolith.
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: The rock-cut monolithic Kailasa temple at Ellora (Cave 16) was excavated during the reign of which Rashtrakuta king?
questions.explanation: Rashtrakuta King Krishna I (c. 756-774 CE) excavated the monolithic Kailasa temple at Ellora.
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: The celebrated Kannada literary work 'Kavirajamarga' was composed during the reign of which monarch?
questions.explanation: Kavirajamarga (c. 850 CE) was patronized by Rashtrakuta King Amoghavarsha I Nrupathunga and authored by Sri Vijaya.
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: Which Hoysala king constructed the renowned Chennakeshava Temple at Belur in 1117 CE to commemorate his victory over the Cholas?
questions.explanation: King Vishnuvardhana (formerly Bittideva) built the Belur Chennakeshava temple after winning the Battle of Talakadu.
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: The Persian ambassador Abdur Razzak visited the Vijayanagara Empire during the reign of which emperor?
questions.explanation: Abdur Razzak visited Vijayanagara in 1443 CE during the reign of Sangama ruler Devaraya II.
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: The historic Battle of Talikota (Rakkasa-Tangadi), which led to the sacking of Vijayanagara, took place in which year?
questions.explanation: The Battle of Talikota took place on 23 January 1565 CE between the Vijayanagara army under Aliya Rama Raya and the combined Deccan Sultanates.
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: Which brave queen of Keladi Nayakas provided asylum to Rajaram, son of Chhatrapati Shivaji, defying the Mughal Emperor Aurangzeb?
questions.explanation: Keladi Rani Chennamma gave shelter to Rajaram in 1689 and defeated the Mughal forces sent by Aurangzeb.
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: Kittur Rani Chennamma led an armed rebellion against the British East India Company in 1824 opposing which British policy?
questions.explanation: Rani Chennamma revolted in 1824 when British Collector St. John Thackeray refused to recognize her adopted son Shivalingappa under the Doctrine of Lapse.
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: Sangolli Rayanna, the legendary military commander who fought guerrilla warfare against the British, was executed by hanging in 1831 at which place?
questions.explanation: Sangolli Rayanna was captured through treachery and hanged by the British at Nandagad on 26 January 1831.
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: The Halagali Bedas uprising of 1857 in Karnataka was triggered by resistance to which British regulation?
questions.explanation: The hunters and martial Bedas of Halagali (Mudhol) revolted when the British ordered them to surrender their traditional firearms under the Disarming Act.
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: The only Indian National Congress (INC) Annual Session ever presided over by Mahatma Gandhi was held in 1924 in which Karnataka town?
questions.explanation: Mahatma Gandhi presided over the 39th Session of the INC held at Belagavi in December 1924.
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: The tragic Vidurashwatha incident (Gowribidanur taluk) of April 1938, where police firing killed 10 Congress satyagrahis, is known as:
questions.explanation: Vidurashwatha is commemorated as the 'Jallianwala Bagh of Karnataka' for the unprovoked firing on satyagrahis hoisting the national tricolor.
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: In which ancient Ashokan edict site in Karnataka was a unique carved stone portrait of Emperor Ashoka inscribed with 'Ranyo Asoko' discovered?
questions.explanation: At Kanaganahalli near Sannati in Kalaburagi district, a limestone relief sculpture of Emperor Ashoka inscribed with 'Ranyo Asoko' was excavated.
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: The Maski edict of Emperor Ashoka holds immense historical significance because it was the first inscription to:

options.label: B
options.text: Mention Ashoka by his personal name rather than merely 'Devanampiya Piyadassi'

questions.explanation: The Maski edict in Raichur (discovered by C. Beadon in 1915) explicitly identified 'Devanampiya Ashoka', confirming Ashoka's identity.
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: The Indus Valley Civilization site of Lothal, renowned for its tidal dockyard, is located in which modern state?
questions.explanation: Lothal is located along the Bhogava river in the Gulf of Khambhat in Gujarat.
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: The Fourth Buddhist Council was convened during the reign of which Kushana monarch at Kundalavana in Kashmir?
questions.explanation: Kanishka I convened the 4th Buddhist Council presided over by Vasumitra with Asvaghosa as deputy, where Buddhism split into Hinayana and Mahayana.
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: The Iron Pillar at Mehrauli in Delhi, renowned for its rustless metallurgy, bears an inscription belonging to which Gupta monarch?
questions.explanation: The Mehrauli pillar commemorates King 'Chandra', identified by historians as Chandragupta II Vikramaditya.
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: Who among the following Delhi Sultans introduced the market control regulations and price rationing system?
questions.explanation: Alauddin Khilji introduced strict market control mechanisms, setting up Shahna-i-Mandi to control prices of grains, cloth, and horses.
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: The Mansabdari administrative system was instituted by which Mughal emperor?
questions.explanation: Akbar introduced the Mansabdari system in 1571 CE, classifying military and civil officials by Zat (personal rank) and Sawar (cavalry quota).
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: The Council of Eight Ministers known as the 'Ashtapradhan' assisted the administration of which ruler?
questions.explanation: Chhatrapati Shivaji's administration was guided by the Ashtapradhan, headed by the Peshwa (Prime Minister).
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: The Permanent Settlement (Zamindari System) of 1793 was introduced in Bengal and Bihar by which Governor-General?
questions.explanation: Lord Cornwallis introduced the Permanent Settlement in 1793 with zamindars recognized as permanent hereditary owners of land.
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: The Ryotwari land revenue settlement was first conceptualized and implemented in the Madras Presidency by:
questions.explanation: Sir Thomas Munro and Captain Alexander Read introduced the Ryotwari system, directly contracting with the individual peasant cultivator (ryot).
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: Who founded the 'Brahmo Samaj' in Calcutta in 1828 to promote monotheism and oppose sati and idolatry?
questions.explanation: Raja Ram Mohan Roy established the Brahmo Samaj in 1828.
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: The Satyashodhak Samaj was founded in Maharashtra in 1873 by which social reformer to challenge Brahminical dominance and uplift non-Brahmins and women?
questions.explanation: Mahatma Jyotirao Phule founded the Satyashodhak Samaj (Truth Seekers' Society) in 1873.
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: The partition of Bengal in 1905 was enacted during the viceroyalty of which British administrator?
questions.explanation: Lord Curzon partitioned Bengal in October 1905 on administrative grounds, triggering the nationwide Swadeshi and Boycott Movement.
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: Who was chosen by Mahatma Gandhi as the first Individual Satyagrahi in October 1940?
questions.explanation: Acharya Vinoba Bhave was chosen as the first individual satyagrahi; Jawaharlal Nehru was the second.
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: The historic 'Purna Swaraj' (Complete Independence) resolution was adopted at which annual session of the Indian National Congress in 1929?
questions.explanation: The Lahore Session of INC (December 1929) presided over by Jawaharlal Nehru declared Purna Swaraj as the ultimate goal.
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: Which is the highest peak in Karnataka, situated in the Western Ghats of Chikkamagaluru district?
questions.explanation: Mullayanagiri in the Baba Budan range of Chikkamagaluru is the highest mountain peak in Karnataka at 1,930 meters (6,332 ft).
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: The world-famous Jog Falls (Gersoppa Falls) in Shivamogga district is formed by which west-flowing river?

questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: The Krishna Water Disputes Tribunal-II (KWDT-II) gave its final award under the chairmanship of which judge?

questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: Which district in Karnataka is famously known as the 'Coffee Land of India' as coffee was first introduced here at Baba Budan Giri?
questions.explanation: Sufi saint Baba Budan brought seven raw coffee beans from Mocha (Yemen) and planted them in the Chandradrona hills of Chikkamagaluru in the 17th century.
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: The boundary line separating the Earth's Crust and Mantle is known as:
questions.explanation: The Mohorovicic (Moho) discontinuity marks the boundary between the crust and the upper mantle.
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: Which of the following ocean currents is a COLD current flowing along the western coast of South America?
questions.explanation: The Humboldt (Peru) Current is a cold, low-salinity ocean current that flows north along the western coast of South America.
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: The subtropical high-pressure belts situated between 30° and 35° North and South latitudes are popularly called:
questions.explanation: The calm, dry subtropical high-pressure belts are historically known as the 'Horse Latitudes'.
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: Which port is known as the 'Gateway of Karnataka', handling iron ore and coffee exports on the Arabian Sea coast?
questions.explanation: New Mangalore Port (Panambur) is Karnataka's only major all-weather port, commissioned in 1974.
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: The tropical cyclone measuring scale that categorizes hurricanes from Category 1 to 5 based on sustained wind speeds is:
questions.explanation: The Saffir-Simpson Hurricane Wind Scale classifies hurricanes from Category 1 to 5.
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: Under the UN Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS), the Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ) of a coastal state extends up to:
questions.explanation: The EEZ extends up to 200 nautical miles (370.4 km) from the coastal baseline.
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: Which plateau in Karnataka is formed predominantly of Archaean Dharwar schist rocks rich in gold, iron ore, and manganese?
questions.explanation: The Karnataka Plateau contains ancient Dharwar schists (Dharwar Craton) rich in Kolar/Hutti gold and Kudremukh/Sandur iron ores.
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: Which river basin dispute involves the states of Karnataka, Goa, and Maharashtra over the Kalasa-Banduri Nala drinking water diversion project?
questions.explanation: The Mahadayi River Water Disputes Tribunal adjudicated the water-sharing dispute between Karnataka, Goa, and Maharashtra.
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: The phenomenon of temperature inversion in the troposphere occurs when:
questions.explanation: Temperature inversion is a reversal of normal lapse rate, where warm air lies over cold air, causing temperature to increase with height.
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: Which Ramsar wetland in Mandya district of Karnataka is situated on an island in the Cauvery River and is a renowned bird sanctuary?
questions.explanation: Ranganathittu Bird Sanctuary in Mandya was declared Karnataka's first Ramsar site in 2022.
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: The 'El Nino' weather phenomenon is characterized by which anomalous oceanic condition in the equatorial Pacific Ocean?

options.label: A
options.text: Abnormal cooling of central and eastern Pacific waters

options.label: B
options.text: Abnormal warming of central and eastern Pacific waters

questions.explanation: El Nino involves periodic warming of sea surface temperatures across the central and east-central equatorial Pacific.
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: Which article of the Constitution of India provides for the writ jurisdiction of the Supreme Court for enforcement of Fundamental Rights?
questions.explanation: Article 32 guarantees the right to constitutional remedies via the Supreme Court (Dr. Ambedkar called it the 'Heart and Soul' of the Constitution).
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: Under which constitutional amendment was Article 371J inserted to provide special provisions and reservations for the Kalyana Karnataka (Hyderabad-Karnataka) region?
questions.explanation: The 98th Constitutional Amendment Act inserted Article 371J, empowering the Governor to establish development boards and quotas for the 6 backward districts.
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: The concept of 'Basic Structure' of the Indian Constitution was propounded by the Supreme Court in which landmark case?

options.label: B
options.text: Kesavananda Bharati v. State of Kerala (1973)

options.label: C
options.text: Minerva Mills v. Union of India (1980)

options.label: D
options.text: Maneka Gandhi v. Union of India (1978)

questions.explanation: The 13-judge bench in Kesavananda Bharati (24 April 1973) held that Parliament cannot alter the basic structure of the Constitution.
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: Karnataka was the pioneer in passing the historic Panchayati Raj Act in 1983 based on the Ashok Mehta Committee model under which visionary Rural Development Minister?
questions.explanation: Abdul Nazir Sab ('Neeru Nazir Sab') conceptualized and enacted the revolutionary 1983 Karnataka Zilla Parishads and Mandal Panchayats Act.
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: In August 2022, the High Court of Karnataka delivered a historic verdict in the Chidananda Urs case, ruling that:

options.label: A
options.text: The Anti-Corruption Bureau (ACB) was unconstitutional and all powers and pending inquiries were restored to the Karnataka Lokayukta

options.label: C
options.text: Local reservation in private IT firms was void

options.label: D
options.text: RTI did not apply to ministers

questions.explanation: The HC abolished the ACB created in 2016 and restored complete police and prosecuting powers back to the Karnataka Lokayukta.
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: The Karnataka Guarantee of Services to Citizens Act (SAKALA) was enacted in which year?
questions.explanation: SAKALA was enacted in 2011 to provide guarantee of services within prescribed time limits to citizens of Karnataka.
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: Who is the ex-officio Chairman of the NITI Aayog (National Institution for Transforming India)?
questions.explanation: The Prime Minister of India serves as the ex-officio Chairman of NITI Aayog.
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: The Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) in India operates under the mandate of targeting consumer price inflation (CPI) at what rate?
questions.explanation: Under Section 45ZB of the RBI Act, the inflation target is 4% CPI inflation with an upper tolerance of 6% and lower tolerance of 2%.
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: The High-Power Committee for Redressal of Regional Imbalances in Karnataka, which submitted its landmark report in 2002, was headed by:
questions.explanation: The Dr. D.M. Nanjundappa Committee identified 114 backward taluks (most in North Karnataka) and formulated the Special Development Plan.
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: Under the Karnataka Fiscal Responsibility Act (KFRA), 2002, what is the statutory ceiling for the state's Fiscal Deficit as a percentage of GSDP?
questions.explanation: KFRA mandates that the state fiscal deficit must be contained within 3% of Gross State Domestic Product (GSDP).
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: The Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) published by NITI Aayog measures acute deprivations across how many core dimensions?

options.label: B
options.text: Three (Health, Education, and Standard of Living)

questions.explanation: The MPI adopts the Alkire-Foster methodology across 3 dimensions: Health, Education, and Standard of Living, spanning 12 indicators.
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: Which constitutional amendment introduced the Goods and Services Tax (GST) regime in India?
questions.explanation: The 101st Constitutional Amendment Act, 2016 introduced GST across India with effect from 1 July 2017.
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: The concept of 'Dominant Caste' in Indian sociology was formulated by which eminent Karnataka-born sociologist based on studies in Rampura village?
questions.explanation: Prof. M. N. Srinivas formulated the concepts of 'Dominant Caste' and 'Sanskritization' from field work in Rampura (Mandya district).
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: Under the Karnataka Scheduled Castes Sub-Allocation and Tribal Sub-Allocation (SCSP/TSP) Act, 2013, what percentage of total state plan outlay is mandatorily earmarked for SC/ST welfare?
questions.explanation: The SCSP/TSP Act mandates 24.1% of the state budget (proportionate to SC 17.15% and ST 6.95% population share) for dedicated welfare.
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: Which expert committee recommended the four-tier internal reservation classification (Left, Right, Touchables, and Others) for Scheduled Castes in Karnataka?

options.label: B
options.text: Justice H. N. Nagamohan Das Commission

questions.explanation: The Justice A. J. Sadashiva Inquiry Commission (submitted 2012) recommended internal reservation to redress uneven benefits among 101 SC castes.
questions.subject: Humanities

questions.text: In the landmark case of State of Punjab v. Davinder Singh (August 2024), a 7-judge Constitution Bench of the Supreme Court held that:

options.label: A
options.text: State governments have no power to create internal reservations within Scheduled Castes.

options.label: B
options.text: State governments possess constitutional authority under Articles 15(4) and 16(4) to sub-classify Scheduled Castes based on empirical data.

options.label: C
options.text: The creamy layer concept can never be applied to Scheduled Castes.

options.label: D
options.text: E.V. Chinnaiah v. State of Andhra Pradesh was correctly decided.

questions.explanation: The 7-judge bench by a 6-1 majority overruled E.V. Chinnaiah (2004) and held that states can sub-classify SCs.
questions.statement_truths: Statement 1 is False; Statement 2 is True; Statement 3 is False.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.text:
Which of the following statements regarding the Yettinahole Integrated Drinking Water Project is/are correct?

2. Phase 1 trial run was inaugurated in September 2024 at Sakleshpura.

questions.text: The Trade and Economic Partnership Agreement (TEPA) signed between India and the European Free Trade Association (EFTA) in March 2024 features an investment commitment of:
questions.explanation: EFTA committed to invest $100 Billion in India over 15 years, creating 1 million direct jobs.
questions.statement_truths: Factually verified via Commerce Ministry TEPA text.

questions.text: Under the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), 2023, which of the following is mandatory for crimes punishable by imprisonment of 7 years or more?

options.label: B
options.text: Audio-video recording of search and seizure operations and forensic examination

questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.text:
Consider the following statements regarding the 2024 Bharat Ratna awards:

2. L.K. Advani was the only living recipient among the five.

questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.text: In the M.K. Ranjitsinh v. Union of India case (2024), the Supreme Court recognized the Right to be Free from Adverse Effects of Climate Change as grounded in:
questions.explanation: The 3-judge bench led by CJI Chandrachud grounded climate resilience in the intersection of Art 21 and Art 14.

questions.text: India's second indigenous nuclear-powered ballistic missile submarine (SSBN) commissioned in August 2024 is:

questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.text: The Nobel Prize in Physics 2024 was awarded to John J. Hopfield and Geoffrey E. Hinton for:

options.label: B
options.text: Foundational discoveries that enable machine learning with artificial neural networks

options.text: MPs and MLAs are completely immune from bribery prosecution under Article 105 and 194.

options.text: Parliamentary immunity does not protect legislators who accept bribes to cast a vote or give a speech.

options.text: Only the Speaker has the power to try a bribe-taking legislator.

questions.text: The 'Angel Tax' in the Income Tax Act was completely abolished in July 2024 under which section?

questions.text: Who was sworn in as the Chief Adviser of the interim government in Bangladesh following Sheikh Hasina's resignation in August 2024?

questions.text: The catastrophic landslide of July 30, 2024 that claimed over 400 lives occurred in which district of Kerala?

questions.text: The 'Shinkun La Tunnel' project inaugurated in July 2024 provides all-weather connectivity between Ladakh and:

questions.text: The 'Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 2024' prescribes a minimum fine of what amount for organized paper leak syndicates?

questions.text: In the 18th Lok Sabha elections, who was officially recognized as the Leader of the Opposition (LoP) for the first time in 10 years?

questions.explanation: The final took place at Kensington Oval, Bridgetown, Barbados.

questions.text: Which of the following writs literally means 'We Command' and is issued to enforce the performance of a public duty?
questions.explanation: Mandamus is a judicial command issued to a public authority to perform an official duty.

questions.text: The concept of 'Procedure Established by Law' under Article 21 was interpreted by the Supreme Court to include 'Due Process of Law' in which landmark case?

options.label: A
options.text: A.K. Gopalan v. State of Madras (1950)

options.label: B
options.text: Maneka Gandhi v. Union of India (1978)

options.label: C
options.text: Kesavananda Bharati v. State of Kerala (1973)

options.label: D
options.text: Minerva Mills v. Union of India (1980)

questions.text: Under Article 368, an amendment bill that affects the federal structure of the Constitution requires:

options.text: Special majority of Parliament and ratification by not less than one-half of the State Legislatures

questions.text: The Comptroller and Auditor General of India (CAG) submits audit reports relating to the accounts of the Union to:

questions.text: The Seventh Schedule of the Indian Constitution distributes legislative powers between Union and States. Under which list is 'Public Health and Sanitation' placed?

questions.text: The Sarkaria Commission on Centre-State Relations was appointed in which year?

questions.text: Which Article of the Constitution guarantees the Right against Self-Incrimination ('No person accused of an offence shall be compelled to be a witness against himself')?

questions.text: Under Article 72, the pardoning power of the President of India is exercised on the advice of:

questions.text: Which schedule of the Indian Constitution contains provisions regarding the administration and control of Scheduled Areas and Scheduled Tribes (other than Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura, Mizoram)?

questions.text: The concept of 'Basic Structure' of the Indian Constitution was propounded by the Supreme Court in:

questions.text: The minimum age required to become a member of the Rajya Sabha is:

questions.text: Under the Gruha Lakshmi Scheme in Karnataka, what is the monthly financial assistance deposited via DBT to eligible women?
questions.explanation: Gruha Lakshmi provides Rs. 2,000 per month DBT to the designated female head of the household.
questions.subject: Karnataka Affairs

questions.text: Who among the following is EXCLUDED from receiving monthly benefits under the Gruha Lakshmi Scheme?

options.label: B
options.text: Women who are themselves or whose husbands are Income Tax or GST assessees

questions.subject: Karnataka Affairs

questions.text: Under the Gruha Jyothi scheme, what is the maximum ceiling of free monthly domestic electricity units allowed per household?
questions.explanation: Gruha Jyothi provides free electricity up to an absolute ceiling of 200 units per month.
questions.subject: Karnataka Affairs

questions.text: How is the entitled free electricity quota determined for a domestic consumer under Gruha Jyothi?

options.label: D
options.text: Based on number of family members

questions.text: Under the Yuva Nidhi scheme, what is the monthly unemployment stipend provided to unemployed Graduates and Diploma holders respectively?

questions.subject: Karnataka Affairs

questions.text: What is the maximum duration for which Yuva Nidhi unemployment assistance is payable to a beneficiary?
questions.explanation: Yuva Nidhi is payable for a maximum tenure of 2 years (24 months) or until employment/self-employment is secured.
questions.subject: Karnataka Affairs

questions.text: The Shakti scheme in Karnataka provides fare-free travel to domicile women across state transport buses, but EXCLUDES which bus service?

options.label: C
options.text: Premium luxury buses like Airavat, Rajahamsa, and EV Power Plus

questions.subject: Karnataka Affairs

questions.text: Under the Anna Bhagya scheme, in lieu of the additional 5 kg rice procurement bottleneck, how much cash is transferred via DBT per person per month?

questions.text: The annual budgetary outlay allocated for the implementation of the Five Guarantees in the Karnataka Budget 2026-27 exceeds approximately:
questions.explanation: The annual budgetary allocation for the Five Guarantees exceeds Rs. 52,000 Crore (~14% of state budget).
questions.subject: Karnataka Affairs

questions.text: The 'Krishi Bhagya' scheme of the Government of Karnataka primarily focuses on which intervention in rainfed agricultural areas?

options.label: B
options.text: Construction of farm ponds (Krishi Honda) and micro-irrigation systems

questions.explanation: Krishi Bhagya promotes farm ponds (Krishi Honda), polythene lining, diesel pumps, and micro-irrigation in dryland farming.
questions.subject: Karnataka Affairs

questions.text: Under the 'Ksheera Bhagya' scheme, how many days a week is milk distributed to children in government schools and Anganwadis in Karnataka?
questions.explanation: Ksheera Bhagya provides 150 ml of milk 5 days a week to school and Anganwadi students.

questions.text: The 'Mathru Poorna' scheme in Karnataka provides which service to pregnant and lactating mothers?

options.label: A
options.text: Cash transfer of Rs. 6,000 in three tranches

questions.explanation: Mathru Poorna delivers one wholesome hot cooked meal daily with milk and eggs at Anganwadi centers.
questions.subject: Karnataka Affairs

questions.text: The 'Raitha Siri' scheme provides financial incentive of Rs. 10,000 per hectare for farmers cultivating which crops in Karnataka?

questions.text: The Yettinahole Integrated Drinking Water Project lifts water from the catchment area in Sakaleshpura to supply drinking water to how many drought-prone districts?

questions.text: Which Hoysala temple complex was inscribed as part of the 'Sacred Ensembles of the Hoysalas' UNESCO World Heritage Site in September 2023?

questions.text: The 87th Akhila Bharata Kannada Sahitya Sammelana held in 2024 was hosted at Mandya under the presidency of which eminent writer and folklorist?

options.text: Reservations for Kannada medium students in jobs

questions.text: In which historic year was the state of 'Mysore' officially renamed as 'Karnataka' under Chief Minister D. Devaraj Urs?

questions.text: The States Reorganisation Commission (SRC) 1955 which created the unified Mysore State on 1 November 1956 was headed by:

questions.text: Who is venerated as 'Kannada Kula Purohita' for spearheading the Karnataka Unification Movement through his book 'Karnataka Gathavaibhava'?

questions.text: Which unified digital delivery portal of the Government of Karnataka acts as the single gateway for citizen services including the Five Guarantees?

questions.text: The Karnataka Lokayukta Act was passed in 1984 under the chief ministership of:

questions.text: The 'Janasevaka' scheme launched in Bengaluru provides which citizen facility?

options.label: A

questions.text: The Karnataka Rajya Raitha Sangha (KRRS) was founded in 1980 by which charismatic peasant leader who led the Malaprabha farmers' agitation?

questions.text: The Dalit Sangharsha Samiti (DSS) in Karnataka was established in 1974 under the intellectual leadership of which prominent writer and activist?

questions.text: How many taluks were categorized as 'Backward' in Karnataka by the High-Power Committee headed by Dr. D. M. Nanjundappa in 2002?

questions.text: The nodal society functioning under the Department of Electronics, IT/Bt for managing tech parks, biotech incubation, and startups in Karnataka is:

questions.text: The Golden Chariot, a luxury tourist train showcasing South Indian heritage, is operated in partnership with which state corporation?

questions.text: The historic lunar landing site of ISRO's Chandrayaan-3 near the Moon's South Pole was officially named as:
questions.explanation: The Chandrayaan-3 landing site was named 'Shiv Shakti Point'; August 23 was declared National Space Day.
questions.subject: Science and Environment

questions.text: Which heavy-lift launch vehicle of ISRO launched the Chandrayaan-3 and OneWeb satellite constellations into orbit?
questions.explanation: LVM3 (formerly GSLV Mk-III) launched Chandrayaan-3 on 14 July 2023.
questions.subject: Science and Environment

questions.text: ISRO's solar observatory Aditya-L1 was placed in a halo orbit around which Sun-Earth Lagrange Point located 1.5 million km from Earth?

questions.subject: Science and Environment

questions.text: What is the name of the female humanoid robot astronaut developed by ISRO for uncrewed test flights of the Gaganyaan mission?

questions.text: The Kaiga Atomic Power Station in Uttara Kannada district of Karnataka operates which type of nuclear reactors?

questions.subject: Science and Environment

questions.text: Which premier artificial intelligence and supercomputing mission was allocated Rs. 10,372 Crore by the Union Cabinet in 2024 to deploy 10,000 GPUs?

questions.subject: Science and Environment

questions.text: The pioneering 'Genome India Project' completed sequencing of how many reference human genomes across diverse Indian populations in 2024?
questions.explanation: The Department of Biotechnology sequenced 10,000 human genomes representative of Indian genetic diversity.
questions.subject: Science and Environment

questions.text: Which indigenous Light Combat Helicopter (LCH) developed by HAL Bengaluru was inducted into the IAF and Indian Army under the name 'Prachand'?
questions.explanation: LCH Prachand is India's dedicated high-altitude attack helicopter manufactured by HAL.
questions.subject: Science and Environment

questions.text: Which of the following National Parks in Karnataka is part of the Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve and India's first Project Tiger reserve in the state?

questions.text: India's first dedicated Butterfly Park was inaugurated in 2006 inside which protected area near Bengaluru?

questions.text: The rare and endangered primate 'Lion-tailed Macaque' (Macaca silenus) is endemic to which ecosystem in Karnataka?

options.label: A
options.text: Dry deciduous thorn scrub of Deccan Maidan

options.label: B
options.text: Tropical evergreen rainforests of Western Ghats

questions.text: Three rivers—Tunga, Bhadra, and Netravati—originate at Gangamoola inside which national park of Karnataka?

questions.text: According to the All-India Tiger Estimation 2022, Karnataka holds which rank in tiger population in India with 563 tigers?

questions.text: The Western Ghats Ecology Expert Panel (WGEEP) which recommended declaring 100% of the Western Ghats as Eco-Sensitive Zones was chaired by:

questions.text: The High-Level Working Group (HLWG) chaired by Dr. K. Kasturirangan recommended that what percentage of the Western Ghats be declared Eco-Sensitive Area (ESA)?

questions.text: Kyasanur Forest Disease (KFD / Monkey Fever) in Karnataka is transmitted to humans through the bite of which tick vector?

questions.text: In an ecological food chain, why is the Pyramid of Energy ALWAYS upright without exception?

options.label: B
options.text: Energy transfer obeys the Second Law of Thermodynamics and 10% law with heat dissipation at each step

options.label: C
options.text: Top carnivores consume more energy than plants

questions.explanation: Energy decreases at each successive trophic level due to metabolic respiration and thermodynamic entropy.

questions.text: The transitional ecological zone between two distinct biological communities (e.g. between land and water) exhibiting high species richness is called:
questions.explanation: An ecotone is the boundary zone between two ecosystems, exhibiting the 'Edge Effect' with rich biodiversity.

questions.text: The National Air Quality Index (AQI) in India monitors how many atmospheric criteria pollutants?
questions.explanation: AQI monitors 8 pollutants: PM10, PM2.5, NO2, SO2, CO, O3, NH3, and Pb (NAAQS monitors 12).

questions.text: Under the Montreal Protocol and its 2016 Kigali Amendment, which potent greenhouse gases are being globally phased down?

questions.subject: Science and Environment

questions.text: The Environment (Protection) Act, 1986 was enacted by Parliament under Article 253 of the Constitution following which major disaster?
