questions.subject: Science and Environment

questions.text: According to the National Family Health Survey-5 (NFHS-5), what is the Total Fertility Rate (TFR) in Karnataka?
questions.explanation: Karnataka's TFR is 1.7 children per woman, well below the demographic replacement level of 2.1.
questions.subject: Science and Environment

questions.text: Karnataka has achieved the Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) target for Maternal Mortality Ratio (MMR) with a ratio of:
questions.explanation: Karnataka's MMR dropped to 69 per 1 lakh live births, beating the SDG 2030 target of <70.
questions.subject: Science and Environment

questions.text: The co-branded Universal Health Coverage scheme providing up to Rs. 5 Lakhs cashless treatment per BPL family in Karnataka is:
questions.explanation: Ayushman Bharat - Arogya Karnataka provides Rs. 5 Lakh per year secondary/tertiary coverage for BPL families.
questions.subject: Science and Environment

questions.text: Which biological invasion of an exotic woody shrub poses a severe threat to native herbivores in Bandipur and Nagarhole Tiger Reserves?
questions.explanation: Lantana camara and Senna spectabilis aggressively colonize undergrowth, displacing indigenous fodder grasses.
questions.subject: Science and Environment

questions.text: The Basel, Rotterdam, and Stockholm Conventions (BRS Triad) deal respectively with which environmental hazards?

options.label: A
options.text: Hazardous waste transboundary movements, Prior Informed Consent for toxic chemicals, and Persistent Organic Pollutants (POPs)

options.label: B
options.text: Ozone depletion, climate change, and wetland conservation

options.label: C
options.text: Endangered trade, migratory birds, and desertification

options.label: D
options.text: Forestry, marine pollution, and carbon markets

questions.explanation: Basel = Hazardous waste movements; Rotterdam = PIC for hazardous chemicals; Stockholm = Eliminating POPs.
questions.subject: Science and Environment

questions.text: Mission LiFE (Lifestyle for Environment) launched by India promotes which behavioral approach to environmental sustainability?

options.label: B
options.text: Individual and community mindful consumer choices replacing mindless consumption

options.label: C
options.text: Exclusive focus on carbon capture technologies

questions.explanation: Mission LiFE mobilizes individual climate-friendly actions (saving energy/water, eliminating single-use plastics).
questions.subject: Science and Environment

questions.text: Which apex environmental judicial tribunal was established in 2010 under Article 21 for expeditious disposal of environmental cases within 6 months?
questions.explanation: The National Green Tribunal (NGT) was established under the NGT Act, 2010.
questions.subject: Science and Environment

questions.text: Read the statement: 'If a polygon has 8 sides, it is an octagon. Shape X is an octagon.' What can be concluded logically?

options.label: B
options.text: Shape X is a regular octagon

questions.explanation: By definition of an octagon, Shape X must have 8 sides.
questions.subject: General Mental Ability

questions.text: In a coded language, if 'DELHI' is coded as 'CCIDD', how will 'BOMBAY' be coded using the same decrement pattern?
questions.explanation: Each letter rank decreases by 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 respectively: B-1=A, O-2=M, M-3=J, B-4=X, A-5=V, Y-6=S.
questions.subject: General Mental Ability

questions.text: A woman introduces a man as 'the son of the only daughter of the father of my maternal grandfather.' How is the man related to the woman?
questions.explanation: The father of her maternal grandfather has an only daughter, who is her maternal grandmother. Her son is the woman's brother or maternal uncle; in direct lineage, Brother.
questions.subject: General Mental Ability

questions.text: A person walks 10 meters North, turns right and walks 6 meters, then turns right and walks 10 meters. How far and in which direction is the person from the starting point?
questions.explanation: The 10m North and 10m South cancel out. The net displacement is 6 meters due East.
questions.subject: General Mental Ability

questions.text: Statements: 1. All mangoes are golden. 2. No golden things are sour. Conclusions: I. All mangoes are not sour. II. Golden mangoes are sour. Which conclusion follows?
questions.explanation: Since all mangoes are golden and no golden thing is sour, it logically follows that no mango is sour (All mangoes are not sour).
questions.subject: General Mental Ability

questions.text: In a row of 40 students facing North, Ramesh is 18th from the left end. What is his position from the right end?
questions.explanation: Position from right $= 	ext{Total} - 	ext{Left} + 1 = 40 - 18 + 1 = 23	ext{rd}$.
questions.subject: General Mental Ability

questions.text: Five friends P, Q, R, S, T are sitting in a circle facing the center. S is to the immediate right of P. Q is sitting between R and P. Who is sitting to the immediate left of P?
questions.explanation: Facing center: Q is between R and P, so Q is immediately adjacent to P on one side. Since S is to P's right, Q must be to P's left.
questions.subject: General Mental Ability

questions.text: Find the missing number in the series: 3, 7, 15, 31, 63, ?
questions.subject: General Mental Ability

questions.text: Statement: 'A major highway landslide has blocked vehicular movement to Kodagu district.' Which course of action should the administration immediately take?

options.label: A
options.text: Wait for rain to cease completely before dispatching any teams

options.label: B
options.text: Immediately deploy earthmovers, divert traffic to alternate state highways, and issue emergency advisories

options.label: C
options.text: Permanently ban all tourist travel to the Western Ghats

options.label: D
options.text: Suspend all district officials in charge of highways

questions.explanation: Action must be proportionate and immediate: clear landslide, provide diversions, issue public advisories.
questions.subject: General Mental Ability

questions.text: A confidential file detailing pending land acquisitions is requested informally by an MLA's aide over the phone. What should the Assistant Commissioner do?

options.label: A
options.text: Hand over the file immediately to avoid political friction

options.label: B
options.text: Politely decline and advise the requester to seek information through formal official channels or RTI

options.label: C
options.text: Leak the document secretly to the media

options.label: D
options.text: Destroy the file to prevent scrutiny

questions.explanation: Public officers must maintain confidentiality and direct requests to lawful statutory channels.
questions.subject: General Mental Ability

questions.text: What is the HCF of two numbers if their product is 2,160 and their LCM is 360?
questions.explanation: $\text{Product} = \text{LCM} \times \text{HCF} \implies \text{HCF} = 2160 / 360 = 6$.
questions.subject: General Mental Ability

questions.text: If 15 men can complete a civil drainage canal in 20 days, how many days will 25 men take to complete the same work?
questions.explanation: $M_1 D_1 = M_2 D_2 \implies 15 \times 20 = 25 \times D_2 \implies D_2 = 300 / 25 = 12\text{ days}$.
questions.subject: General Mental Ability

questions.text: A shopkeeper marks an article 40% above its cost price and allows a discount of 20% on the marked price. What is his net profit percentage?
questions.subject: General Mental Ability

questions.text: A sum of money doubles itself in 5 years at simple interest. In how many years will it become 4 times the principal at the same rate?
questions.explanation: Doubles $\implies SI = P$ in 5 yrs. 4 times $\implies SI = 3P$. Time $= 3 \times 5 = 15\text{ years}$.
questions.subject: General Mental Ability

questions.text: The difference between compound interest (compounded annually) and simple interest on Rs. 20,000 at 5% per annum for 2 years is:
questions.subject: General Mental Ability

questions.text: A train 180 meters long is traveling at a speed of 54 km/hr. How much time will it take to pass an electric pole?
questions.explanation: $54\text{ km/h} = 54 \times 5/18 = 15\text{ m/s}$. Time $= 180 / 15 = 12\text{ seconds}$.
questions.subject: General Mental Ability

questions.text: The average age of 24 students in a classroom is 15 years. If the teacher's age is included, the average increases by 1 year. What is the teacher's age?
questions.explanation: Total age of 24 students $= 24 \times 15 = 360$. Total age of 25 people $= 25 \times 16 = 400$. Teacher $= 400 - 360 = 40\text{ years}$.
questions.subject: General Mental Ability

questions.text: If the ratio of two numbers is 3 : 5 and their sum is 240, what is the larger number?
questions.explanation: Parts $= 3 + 5 = 8$. One part $= 240 / 8 = 30$. Larger number $= 5 \times 30 = 150$.
questions.subject: General Mental Ability

questions.text: A car covers first 60 km at 30 km/hr and the next 60 km at 60 km/hr. What is the average speed of the car for the entire 120 km trip?
questions.explanation: $\text{Average speed} = \frac{2uv}{u+v} = \frac{2 \times 30 \times 60}{30 + 60} = \frac{3600}{90} = 40\text{ km/hr}$.
questions.subject: General Mental Ability

questions.text: In a village election between two candidates, the winner polled 65% of the total votes and won by a majority of 600 votes. How many total votes were polled?
questions.subject: General Mental Ability

questions.text: In a circular pie chart representing a state budget expenditure, the sector for 'Education' has an angle of 72 degrees. What percentage of the budget is spent on Education?
questions.explanation: Percentage $= (72 / 360) \times 100 = 20\%$.
questions.subject: General Mental Ability

questions.text: If the Mean of a dataset is 28 and the Median is 30, what is the empirical Mode according to Karl Pearson's formula?
questions.subject: General Mental Ability

questions.text: Which measure of central tendency is LEAST affected by extreme outlier values in a skewed income distribution?
questions.explanation: The Median represents the middle positional value and is robust against extreme outliers.
questions.subject: General Mental Ability

questions.text: The Coefficient of Variation (CV) of two crop yield series A and B are 18% and 26% respectively. Which series exhibits greater consistency?

options.label: D
options.text: Cannot be determined without knowing the sample size

questions.explanation: A lower Coefficient of Variation ($CV = \sigma / \bar{x} \times 100$) indicates greater consistency and lower dispersion.
questions.subject: General Mental Ability

questions.text: In a bar chart comparing district pulses production, District A produces 120 tonnes in 2023 and 150 tonnes in 2024. What is the percentage increase in production?
questions.subject: General Mental Ability

questions.text: A bag contains 5 red balls, 4 blue balls, and 3 green balls. If one ball is drawn at random, what is the probability that it is blue?
questions.explanation: Total balls $= 5 + 4 + 3 = 12$. Blue balls $= 4$. Probability $= 4 / 12 = 1/3$.
questions.subject: General Mental Ability

questions.text: What is the Standard Deviation of the set of numbers: 5, 5, 5, 5, 5?
questions.explanation: Since all values are identical to the mean, there is zero dispersion: $\text{Standard Deviation} = 0$.
questions.subject: General Mental Ability

questions.text: What is the median of the following set of observations: 12, 7, 19, 4, 15, 9, 21?
questions.explanation: Arranged in ascending order: 4, 7, 9, 12, 15, 19, 21. Middle (4th) observation is 12.
questions.subject: General Mental Ability

questions.text: Which graphical representation is used to display continuous grouped frequency data where bars touch each other without gaps?
questions.explanation: A histogram displays continuous class interval data with contiguous adjacent rectangles.
questions.subject: General Mental Ability

questions.text: In a village survey of 500 households, 300 own cattle and 250 own sheep. If 100 households own both, how many households own NEITHER cattle nor sheep?
questions.explanation: $\text{Total owning either} = 300 + 250 - 100 = 450$. Owning neither $= 500 - 450 = 50$.
questions.subject: General Mental Ability

questions.text: The earliest known stone inscription written in the Kannada language is the:
questions.explanation: The Halmidi inscription discovered in Belur taluk, Hassan, dating to c. 450 CE under Kadamba King Kakusthavarma, is the earliest Kannada stone epigraph.
questions.subject: Karnataka Affairs

questions.text: Which Kadamba ruler founded the dynasty at Banavasi after being insulted by Pallava guards at Kanchi?
questions.explanation: Mayurasharma founded the Kadamba dynasty around 345 CE at Banavasi, recorded in the Talagunda pillar inscription.
questions.subject: Karnataka Affairs

questions.text: The Aihole Prasasti (634 CE) celebrating the military triumphs of Badami Chalukya emperor Pulakeshin II was composed by:
questions.explanation: Jain poet Ravikirti composed the Aihole inscription in classical Sanskrit verse.
questions.subject: Karnataka Affairs

questions.text: Kavirajamarga (c. 850 CE), the earliest surviving poetic treatise in Kannada, was patronized by which Rashtrakuta monarch?
questions.explanation: Amoghavarsha I Nrupatunga patronized Kavirajamarga, composed by court poet Srivijaya.
questions.subject: Karnataka Affairs

questions.text: The 12th-century socio-religious reform movement in Karnataka spearheaded by Basaveshwara established which democratic spiritual parliament at Basavakalyana?
questions.explanation: Basaveshwara established the Anubhava Mantapa, where Sharanas of all castes discussed philosophy via Vachanas.
questions.subject: Karnataka Affairs

questions.text: The Hoysala empire reached its architectural and political zenith under Vishnuvardhana following his victory at Talakadu in 1116 CE, earning him the title:
questions.explanation: Vishnuvardhana assumed the title Talakadugonda after expelling the Cholas from southern Karnataka.
questions.subject: Karnataka Affairs

questions.text: The Vijayanagara Empire was founded in 1336 CE on the southern banks of the Tungabhadra river by Harihara I and Bukka I under the spiritual inspiration of:
questions.explanation: Sage Vidyaranya of the Sringeri Sharada Peetham inspired the founding of the Vijayanagara Empire.
questions.subject: Karnataka Affairs

questions.text: The 'Whispering Gallery' where even the faintest whisper echoes multiple times is located in which monument in Karnataka?
questions.explanation: Gol Gumbaz, the mausoleum of Muhammad Adil Shah in Vijayapura, features the acoustic Whispering Gallery.
questions.subject: Karnataka Affairs

questions.text: The revenue land settlement system known as 'Sist' in Karnataka was introduced by which Keladi Nayaka ruler?
questions.explanation: Shivappa Nayaka introduced the scientific agrarian land revenue assessment known as 'Shivappa Nayakana Sist'.
questions.subject: Karnataka Affairs

questions.text: Which brave woman defender of Chitradurga Fort fought Hyder Ali's invading soldiers with a wooden pestle at the secret opening (Kindi)?
questions.explanation: Onake Obavva valiantly defended Chitradurga's secret crevice (Onake Obavvana Kindi) in 1779.
questions.subject: Karnataka Affairs

questions.text: The historic armed uprising of Kittur against the British East India Company in 1824 was led by:
questions.explanation: Kittur Rani Chennamma rebelled against Collector Thackeray when the British refused to recognize her adopted son Shivalingappa.
questions.subject: Karnataka Affairs

questions.text: Sangolli Rayanna, the legendary guerrilla commander who led the 1829-1831 revolt in Kittur, was hanged by the British at:
questions.explanation: Rayanna was hanged on 26 January 1831 from a banyan tree at Nandagad in Belagavi district.
questions.subject: Karnataka Affairs

questions.text: The only session of the Indian National Congress ever presided over by Mahatma Gandhi was held in 1924 at:
questions.explanation: Mahatma Gandhi presided over the 39th INC Session at Belagavi in December 1924.
questions.subject: Karnataka Affairs

questions.text: The tragic firing on freedom fighters at Vidurashwatha (Kolar/Chikkaballapura) in April 1938 is nationally commemorated as:
questions.explanation: Vidurashwatha tragedy is known as the 'Jallianwala Bagh of the South' where 32 satyagrahis were martyred.
questions.subject: Karnataka Affairs

questions.text: The historic movement where villagers declared independence and formed a parallel government in Shivamogga in 1942 was centered at:
questions.explanation: Isur village in Shikaripura taluk declared independence during the Quit India Movement in 1942.
questions.subject: Karnataka Affairs

questions.text: The pioneering Kannada cultural work 'Karnataka Gatha Vaibhava' (1912), which ignited the Unification movement, was authored by:
questions.explanation: Aluru Venkata Rao wrote Karnataka Gatha Vaibhava in Dharwad to awaken Kannada linguistic unity.
questions.subject: Karnataka Affairs

questions.text: The State of Mysore was officially renamed as 'Karnataka' on 1 November 1973 under the Chief Ministership of:
questions.explanation: Chief Minister D. Devaraj Urs steered the historic renaming of Mysore State to Karnataka in 1973.
questions.subject: Karnataka Affairs

questions.text: Which committee appointed in 2000 identified 114 backward taluks in Karnataka and recommended a special economic package to rectify regional imbalances?
questions.explanation: Dr. D.M. Nanjundappa High Power Committee submitted its landmark report on regional imbalances in 2002.
questions.subject: Karnataka Affairs

questions.text: Article 371J of the Constitution, providing special provisions for Kalyana Karnataka, was inserted by which Constitutional Amendment Act?
questions.explanation: The 98th Constitutional Amendment Act, 2012 inserted Article 371J.
questions.subject: Karnataka Affairs

questions.text: The highest peak in Karnataka, situated at 1,930 metres elevation in the Bababudan Giri range of Chikkamagaluru, is:
questions.explanation: Mullayanagiri (1,930 m) is the highest mountain peak in Karnataka.
questions.subject: Karnataka Affairs

questions.text: Which river forms the spectacular Jog Falls (Gersoppa Falls), dropping 253 metres in Shivamogga district?
questions.explanation: The Sharavathi river creates the Jog Falls (Raja, Roarer, Rocket, and Rani cascades).
questions.subject: Karnataka Affairs

questions.text: The driest meteorological station in Karnataka, receiving less than 450 mm of annual rainfall, is:
questions.explanation: Challakere in Chitradurga is the driest locality in Karnataka.
questions.subject: Karnataka Affairs

questions.text: Karnataka ranks second only to which Indian state in total arid and semi-arid drought-prone geographical land area?
questions.explanation: Karnataka has the second largest drought-prone arid land area in India after Rajasthan.
questions.subject: Karnataka Affairs

questions.text: Under the Champion & Seth forest classification, the hyper-humid Western Ghats crestline in Karnataka is dominated by:
questions.explanation: Tropical Wet Evergreen forests dominate high-rainfall zones (>2,500 mm) in the Western Ghats.
questions.subject: Karnataka Affairs

questions.text: Which national park in Karnataka was declared a Project Tiger reserve in 1973 and forms a keystone part of the Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve?
questions.explanation: Bandipur was one of India's original 9 Project Tiger reserves designated in 1973.
questions.subject: Karnataka Affairs

questions.text: The 'Aghanashini Estuary', inscribed as a Ramsar site in 2024, is located in which coastal taluk of Uttara Kannada?
questions.explanation: Aghanashini estuary is situated in Kumta taluk, Uttara Kannada.
questions.subject: Karnataka Affairs

questions.text: Karnataka produces approximately what percentage of India's total coffee output?
questions.explanation: Karnataka accounts for ~70% of India's total coffee production (Kodagu, Chikkamagaluru, Hassan).
questions.subject: Karnataka Affairs

questions.text: Which district in Karnataka is officially designated the 'Dal Bowl of Karnataka' (Togari Kanaja) and holds a GI tag for Red Gram?
questions.explanation: Kalaburagi is the Dal Bowl of Karnataka, producing premier GI-tagged red gram.
questions.subject: Karnataka Affairs

questions.text: The 'Shanti Sagara' (Sulekere) ancient irrigation tank in Davanagere district is renowned as:

options.label: A
options.text: The largest natural lake in South India

options.label: B
options.text: Asia's second largest ancient man-made irrigation tank

options.label: C
options.text: The deepest crater lake in Karnataka

options.label: D
options.text: The oldest stepwell in peninsular India

questions.explanation: Shanti Sagara (Sulekere), constructed in the 12th century, is Asia's 2nd largest ancient artificial tank.
questions.subject: Karnataka Affairs

questions.text: Currently, the ONLY operational commercial primary gold producer in India is:
questions.explanation: Hutti Gold Mines Company Limited (HGML) in Raichur is India's only active primary gold producer.
questions.subject: Karnataka Affairs

questions.text: The 'Pavagada Solar Park' (Shakti Sthala) with an installed capacity of 2,050 MW is located in which district?
questions.explanation: Pavagada Solar Park spans 13,000 acres in Pavagada taluk, Tumakuru district.
questions.subject: Karnataka Affairs

questions.text: Which nuclear power reactor in Karnataka set a world record for continuous operation without shutdown for 962 days?
questions.explanation: Kaiga Unit 1 (220 MWe PHWR) operated continuously for 962 days until December 2018.
questions.subject: Karnataka Affairs

questions.text: Asia's first major commercial hydroelectric power station was commissioned in Karnataka in 1902 at:
questions.explanation: Shivanasamudra hydroelectric station on the Cauvery river was commissioned in 1902 to power KGF.
questions.subject: Karnataka Affairs

questions.text: According to Census 2011, which district has the HIGHEST sex ratio in Karnataka?
questions.explanation: Udupi has the highest sex ratio (1,094), while Bengaluru Urban has the lowest (916).
questions.subject: Karnataka Affairs

questions.text: According to Census 2011, which district has the LOWEST literacy rate in Karnataka?
questions.explanation: Yadgir records the lowest literacy in Karnataka (51.83%), while Dakshina Kannada records the highest (88.57%).
questions.subject: Karnataka Affairs

questions.text: The ONLY Major Port located in the state of Karnataka is:
questions.explanation: New Mangalore Port (NMPT) is Karnataka's sole Major Port administered under central port authorities.
questions.subject: Karnataka Affairs

questions.text: The world's longest railway platform (1,507 metres), recognized by the Guinness World Records, is situated at:

options.label: C
options.text: Shree Siddharoodha Swamiji Hubballi Railway Station

questions.explanation: Hubballi railway station (SWR headquarters) houses the world's longest platform (1,507 m).
questions.subject: Karnataka Affairs

questions.text: Under the Karnataka 'Gruha Lakshmi' scheme, what is the monthly direct benefit transfer provided to eligible female heads of households?
questions.explanation: Gruha Lakshmi provides ₹2,000 per month DBT to the woman head of eligible households.
questions.subject: Karnataka Affairs

questions.text: The 'Shakti' scheme implemented by the Government of Karnataka provides fare-free travel to women on which transport services?

options.label: B
options.text: Ordinary, Express, and City buses of four state RTCs within Karnataka

questions.explanation: Shakti provides free travel to women residing in Karnataka on state RTC buses within state borders.
questions.subject: Karnataka Affairs

questions.text: The 'Krishi Bhagya' scheme of Karnataka is primarily targeted at supporting:

options.label: B
options.text: Rainfed dryland farmers through farm ponds (Krishi Honda) and micro-irrigation

questions.explanation: Krishi Bhagya supports dryland farmers with farm ponds, polythene lining, diesel pumps, and micro-irrigation.
questions.subject: Karnataka Affairs

questions.text: The 'Raman Effect', discovered by Sir C.V. Raman at Kolkata in 1928, is based on which optical phenomenon?

options.label: B
options.text: Inelastic scattering of photons by molecules

options.label: C
options.text: Diffraction of light by ultrasonic waves

questions.explanation: Raman Effect is the inelastic scattering of light where scattered photons have altered energy and wavelength.
questions.subject: Science and Environment

questions.text: Which organelle in eukaryotic cells is universally referred to as the 'Powerhouse of the Cell' due to ATP generation via oxidative phosphorylation?
questions.explanation: Mitochondria generate adenosine triphosphate (ATP) through cellular respiration.
questions.subject: Science and Environment

questions.text: CRISPR-Cas9 technology, which won the Nobel Prize in Chemistry in 2020, is primarily used for:

options.label: B
options.text: Targeted gene editing and genome engineering

questions.explanation: CRISPR-Cas9 is a revolutionary molecular scissors system for precise DNA sequences editing.
questions.subject: Science and Environment

questions.text: The phenomenon of 'Ocean Acidification' is primarily driven by the excessive absorption of which atmospheric gas by seawater?
questions.explanation: Oceans absorb excess CO2, reacting with water to form carbonic acid, lowering ocean pH.
questions.subject: Science and Environment

questions.text: Which layer of the atmosphere contains the protective Ozone Layer that absorbs lethal solar ultraviolet-B radiation?
questions.explanation: The stratospheric ozone layer (15-35 km altitude) filters out harmful UV-B radiation.
questions.subject: Science and Environment

questions.text: The 'Montreal Protocol' (1987) is an international environmental treaty aimed at phasing out substances that cause:

options.label: B
options.text: Depletion of the Ozone Layer (ODS like CFCs and halons)

questions.explanation: The Montreal Protocol mandates the phase-out of ozone-depleting substances.
questions.subject: Science and Environment

questions.text: Which artificial intelligence model developed by Google DeepMind solved the 50-year-old biological challenge of predicting 3D protein structures from amino acid sequences?
questions.explanation: AlphaFold revolutionized structural biology, earning its creators the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry.
questions.subject: Science and Environment

questions.text: The 'James Webb Space Telescope' (JWST) operates primarily in which region of the electromagnetic spectrum?
questions.explanation: JWST observes in infrared wavelengths to peer through cosmic dust and observe the earliest galaxies.
questions.subject: Science and Environment

questions.text: Which metal is in a liquid state at room temperature (25°C)?
questions.explanation: Mercury is the only elemental metal that is liquid at standard room temperature.
questions.subject: Science and Environment

questions.text: The 'Minamata Disease' is a severe neurological syndrome caused by toxic poisoning from which industrial pollutant?
questions.explanation: Minamata disease in Japan was caused by the release of methylmercury into industrial wastewater.
questions.subject: Science and Environment

questions.text: In nuclear reactors, 'Heavy Water' ($D_2O$) is used primarily as a:

options.label: B
options.text: Moderator to slow down fast neutrons and Coolant

questions.explanation: Deuterium oxide slows fast fission neutrons to thermal speeds to sustain chain reactions in PHWRs.
questions.subject: Science and Environment

questions.text: Which Indian space mission was launched in September 2023 to study the solar corona and solar wind from the Sun-Earth Lagrangian Point 1 (L1)?
questions.explanation: Aditya-L1 was placed in a halo orbit around Lagrangian Point 1 (1.5 million km from Earth).
questions.subject: Science and Environment

questions.text: The chemical substance responsible for the depletion of dissolved oxygen and subsequent fish mortality during 'Eutrophication' of water bodies is:

options.label: B
options.text: Excessive agricultural runoff of Nitrates and Phosphates inducing algal blooms

questions.explanation: Nitrogen and phosphorus runoff causes explosive algal growth; decaying algae depletes dissolved oxygen.
questions.subject: Science and Environment

questions.text: The 'Stockholm Convention' (2001) is a multilateral environmental agreement that restricts and eliminates:
questions.explanation: The Stockholm Convention targets Persistent Organic Pollutants like DDT, dioxins, and PCBs.
questions.subject: Science and Environment

questions.text: Which blood cells are responsible for immune defense by producing antibodies against pathogenic infections?
questions.explanation: B-lymphocytes mature into plasma cells that secrete antigen-specific antibodies.
questions.subject: Science and Environment

questions.text: The 'Kigali Amendment' (2016) to the Montreal Protocol aims to gradually phase down which potent greenhouse gases?
questions.explanation: The Kigali Amendment phases down HFCs, which replaced CFCs but have high global warming potential.
questions.subject: Science and Environment

questions.text: The phenomenon where an uncrewed spacecraft burns up due to frictional heating during atmospheric entry is governed by:

options.label: A
options.text: Kinetic aerodynamic drag converting velocity into extreme thermal shock

questions.explanation: Extreme compression and aerodynamic drag of air parcels generate hypersonic plasma shock layers.
questions.subject: Science and Environment

questions.text: Which of the following is an example of an In-situ conservation strategy for biodiversity?
questions.explanation: In-situ conservation protects species within their natural ecosystems (National Parks, Sanctuaries).
questions.subject: Science and Environment

questions.text: The conversion of atmospheric nitrogen ($N_2$) into ammonia ($NH_3$) by symbiotic bacteria like Rhizobium in leguminous root nodules is called:
questions.explanation: Biological nitrogen fixation converts inert N2 into bioavailable ammonia via the nitrogenase enzyme.
questions.subject: Science and Environment

questions.text: The 'Greenhouse Effect' is caused because greenhouse gases absorb and re-emit which type of radiation emitted by Earth?
questions.explanation: Greenhouse gases absorb outgoing longwave infrared radiation emitted by the warmed Earth surface.
questions.subject: Science and Environment

questions.text: Which gas is predominantly present in compressed natural gas (CNG) and biogas?
questions.explanation: Methane constitutes over 85-90% of CNG and biogas.
questions.subject: Science and Environment

questions.text: The 'Kyoto Protocol' (1997) categorized greenhouse gas emissions under which flexible market mechanisms?

options.label: A
options.text: Clean Development Mechanism (CDM), Joint Implementation, and Emissions Trading

questions.explanation: Kyoto Protocol established CDM, Joint Implementation, and International Emissions Trading.
questions.subject: Science and Environment

questions.text: Which vitamin is synthesized in the human skin upon exposure to solar ultraviolet-B radiation?
questions.explanation: 7-dehydrocholesterol in the epidermis is photochemically converted into Vitamin D3 by UV-B.
questions.subject: Science and Environment

questions.text: The 'Global Warming Potential' (GWP) of greenhouse gases is measured relative to which baseline gas?
questions.explanation: Carbon dioxide has a GWP baseline value of 1 over a 100-year timescale.
questions.subject: Science and Environment

questions.text: The process by which plants lose water vapor through microscopic stomatal pores on leaves is known as:
questions.explanation: Transpiration is the evaporative loss of water vapor from aerial plant organs.
questions.subject: Science and Environment

questions.text: The 'Basel Convention' (1989) regulates the international control of:

options.label: A
options.text: Trade in endangered wild flora and fauna

options.label: B
options.text: Transboundary movements of hazardous wastes and their disposal

Question 1: Concerning economic concepts, fiscal policy, and Karnataka's economy:
What is the primary statutory objective of the RBI Monetary Policy Committee under the amended RBI Act, 1934?

options.label: B
options.text: Maintaining price stability with target inflation of 4% +/- 2% while keeping in mind growth

questions.explanation: The MPC is mandated to maintain headline CPI inflation at 4% within a tolerance band of +/- 2%.
questions.subject: Economy

questions.text:
Question 2: Concerning economic concepts, fiscal policy, and Karnataka's economy:
In Karnataka's State Budget 2024-25, what was the approximate total outlay allocated for the Five Guarantees?
questions.explanation: Over ₹52,000 Crore was allocated to fund the Five Guarantees in Budget 2024-25.
questions.subject: Economy

questions.text:
Question 3: Concerning economic concepts, fiscal policy, and Karnataka's economy:
Which district in Karnataka is officially known as the 'Dal Bowl of Karnataka' and holds a GI tag for Red Gram?
questions.explanation: Kalaburagi is renowned as the Dal Bowl of Karnataka, producing premier red gram.
questions.subject: Economy

questions.text:

questions.explanation: Section 56(2)(viib) taxed share capital received above fair market value, completely abolished in July 2024.

Question 1: In the context of Karnataka history and dynasties, examine the historical statement:
Which inscription is considered the earliest documented stone epigraph in the Kannada language?
questions.explanation: Halmidi inscription in Belur taluk, Hassan district, under Kadamba King Kakusthavarma, is the earliest Kannada stone epigraph.
questions.subject: Karnataka History

questions.text:
Question 2: In the context of Karnataka history and dynasties, examine the historical statement:
The famous Battle of Rakshasi-Tangadi (Talikota) which led to the sacking of Vijayanagara took place in which year?
questions.explanation: The Battle of Talikota was fought on 23 January 1565 CE between the Vijayanagara Empire and the combined Deccan Sultanates.
questions.subject: Karnataka History

questions.text:
Question 3: In the context of Karnataka history and dynasties, examine the historical statement:
The Vachana movement and Anubhava Mantapa at Basavakalyana were patronized during the reign of which Kalachuri king?
questions.explanation: Bijjala II of the Kalachuri dynasty appointed Basaveshwara as prime minister and treasurer at Kalyana.
questions.subject: Karnataka History

questions.text:
Question 4: In the context of Karnataka history and dynasties, examine the historical statement:
Who among the following was the author of 'Kavirajamarga', the earliest surviving Kannada literary work on poetics?
questions.explanation: Kavirajamarga (c. 850 CE) was written by court poet Srivijaya under Rashtrakuta emperor Amoghavarsha I.
questions.subject: Karnataka History

questions.text:
